overview_description.description:
Groww is an investment platform that offers a new way of investing money with stockbroking and direct mutual funds.

The platform provides insights about mutual funds, systematic investment planning, equity-linked savings, and everything from the personal finance world, which helps new investors make investing simple by maintaining a simplified user interface to make investing easy, accessible, transparent, and paperless, enabling users to invest in mutual funds without any hassles. Customers can also invest in gold and US stocks through the Groww platform. The company is also a part of Y Combinator’s winter 2018 batch.
Founded in 2017 by Lalit Keshre, Harsh Jain, Neeraj Singh, and Ishan Bansal, the company was launched in Bengaluru, Karnataka.

about_short_description.short_description: Groww is a financial services company that offers a range of investment products with stockbroking and direct mutual funds.

product.name: Groww Investment and Trading Platform
product.description: A digital platform for opening accounts, investing, trading, monitoring portfolios, and accessing market information across multiple financial products.

product.name: Stocks
product.description: An online stockbroking service for buying and selling listed equities, tracking holdings, and monitoring real-time profit and loss across NSE and BSE securities.

product.name: Direct Mutual Funds
product.description: An online mutual fund investment service offering direct plans through lump-sum investments and systematic investment plans, with screening, comparison, and portfolio tracking tools.

product.name: Futures and Options (F&O) Trading
product.description: A derivatives trading service for futures and options on eligible stocks and market indices, with order management, charts, option analysis, and position monitoring.

product.name: ETFs
product.description: An exchange-traded fund investment service covering equity, debt, commodity, international, index, gold, and silver ETFs available through the stock market.

product.name: IPO Investing
product.description: An online service for discovering and applying to initial public offerings, including mainboard and SME issues, with subscription, allotment, and status tracking.
